# A vending machine against the right wall (X 3.8..4.6, Z 0.2..1.2, 2.0 m tall), its front facing the
# court (-X): a blue body, a lit window of cans (unlit, textures/cans.png), a lit header, an ink pay panel
# and pickup flap, each stood off the front by 4 cm. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Body --base-color 0.0000 0.5137 0.7843 --no-slot
material new Window --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Header --base-color 0.9451 0.9451 0.9176 --no-slot
material new Panel --base-color 0.1608 0.1529 0.1961 --no-slot
material new Button --base-color 0.8039 0.2392 0.2392 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Body --size 1 --location 4.2000 -0.7000 1.0200
scale 0.8000 1.0000 1.9600
apply --scale
material assign Body
select Body
active Body
mode edit
select face where "!(normal.x < 0.9 && normal.z > -0.9)"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name Win --size 1 --location 3.7700 -0.5500 1.2500
scale 0.0600 0.5600 1.0000
apply --scale
material assign Window
select Win
active Win
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view left --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh cube --name Head --size 1 --location 3.7700 -0.7000 1.8700
scale 0.0600 0.8600 0.1400
apply --scale
material assign Header
add mesh cube --name Pay --size 1 --location 3.7700 -1.0150 1.2750
scale 0.0600 0.2300 0.6500
apply --scale
material assign Panel
add mesh cube --name Btn --size 1 --location 3.7200 -1.0150 1.3600
scale 0.0400 0.0900 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Button
add mesh cube --name Flap --size 1 --location 3.7700 -0.5500 0.3500
scale 0.0600 0.4600 0.2600
apply --scale
material assign Panel
add mesh cube --name Feet --size 1 --location 4.2000 -0.7000 0.0200
scale 0.7600 0.9200 0.0400
apply --scale
material assign Panel
material texture Window base-color textures/cans.png
select all
shade flat
export vend.glb
